verifications.claim: Artemis II is NASA's first crewed mission to the Moon in over 50 years.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'Artemis II will mark the first time humans have traveled beyond low Earth orbit in more than 50 years. The last mission to do so was Apollo 17 in 1972.'; R3: 'first crewed mission of the Artemis programme... for the first time in over half a century.'; R6: 'first crewed mission to the Moon since 1972.'
verifications.reasoning: Multiple sources explicitly state Artemis II is the first crewed mission beyond low Earth orbit or to the Moon vicinity since Apollo 17 in 1972, over 50 years prior.

verifications.claim: Artemis II is slated as a 10-day test flight around the lunar far side and back to Earth.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: '10-day journey around the moon (a lunar flyby)'; R2: '10 days around the moon and back'; R3: '10 days'; R5: 'MISSION DURATION 9 Days, 1 Hour, 32 Minutes' (actual close to 10); R6: '10-day Artemis II mission'; R10: 'nearly 10 days'.
verifications.reasoning: All sources confirm ~10-day test flight with lunar flyby around far side and return to Earth splashdown.

verifications.claim: Artemis II will launch four astronauts named Reid Wiseman, Victor Glover, Christina Koch, and Jeremy Hansen.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'Commander Reid Wiseman, pilot Victor Glover, mission specialist Christina Koch, and Jeremy Hansen'; identical in R3, R4, R5, R6, R10.
verifications.reasoning: Exact crew names listed consistently across all sources.

verifications.claim: Reid Wiseman, Victor Glover, Christina Koch, and Jeremy Hansen will be launched aboard the Space Launch System (SLS) rocket.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'Space Launch System (SLS), the rocket that carries the astronauts into space'; R3: 'NASA’s Space Launch System (SLS) rocket will launch'; R5: 'SLS (Space Launch System) rocket'.
verifications.reasoning: Sources confirm SLS launches the named crew.

verifications.claim: Reid Wiseman, Victor Glover, Christina Koch, and Jeremy Hansen will be launched aboard the Orion spacecraft.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'Orion crew capsule, which is their spacecraft'; R2: 'NASA’s Orion spacecraft'; R3: 'Orion spacecraft and its crew'; all sources confirm Orion carries the named crew.
verifications.reasoning: All sources state the named crew flies in Orion.

verifications.claim: Artemis II will test critical life-support systems
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'NASA will test life support, communications, and navigation systems'; R3: 'life support systems to keep the crew safe'; R5: 'test Orion’s life-support'; R6: 'flight test Orion’s life-support systems'.
verifications.reasoning: Sources directly state testing of life-support systems as a key objective.
